tasks.title: Healthy cooking at work
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: In your English class you have been talking about how to encourage healthy cooking at work. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.
paragraphs: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Healthy cooking workshop review
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you attended a healthy cooking workshop at your workplace or in your community? Write a review of the workshop for our specialist magazine.
Describe what you learned, say how useful the session was, and explain whether you would recommend it to other workplaces.
The best reviews will be published in next month's issue.

tasks.title: Healthy cooking at the workplace
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our programme coordinator wants to hear from employees about healthy cooking at work.
Write an article for the company newsletter suggesting one practical way to make healthy cooking easier at the workplace. Explain why this idea would work and what the benefits would be for staff.
We will share the best ideas with the planning team.

tasks.title: Healthy cooking initiative
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Healthy cooking at work
paragraphs: I heard your office is starting a healthy cooking initiative. I'm thinking of suggesting something similar at my company.
Could you tell me what has worked well so far? What challenges have you faced? And how did you get people interested?

taskReviews.scenario: a workplace wellbeing pilot planning brief 34: essay brief 1-1
taskReviews.originalitySelfCheck: Essay uses notes 'providing kitchen facilities' and 'organising cooking workshops' with own idea. Different from previous essays which used notes like 'managing money', 'frequency of buses', etc. Scenario is workplace healthy cooking, not generic environment or education. PASS.

taskReviews.scenario: a workplace wellbeing pilot planning brief 34: review brief 2-5
taskReviews.originalitySelfCheck: Review asks about a healthy cooking workshop at workplace or community. Not a book review, film review, or library review. Different from previous reviews which covered books, study clinics, documentaries, etc. PASS.

taskReviews.scenario: a workplace wellbeing pilot planning brief 34: article brief 3-9
taskReviews.originalitySelfCheck: Article suggests a practical way to make healthy cooking easier at work. Not about learning outside class, supporting small businesses, or youth participation. Different audience and purpose. PASS.

taskReviews.scenario: a workplace wellbeing pilot planning brief 34: email brief 4-13
taskReviews.purpose: explain a position and request arrangements
taskReviews.originalitySelfCheck: Email from Elena asking about a healthy cooking initiative at work. Not about weekend job, exchange visit, or festival. Different from previous emails. PASS.
